tytul: Metka: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for metka, a raw smoked spreadable sausage made from minced meat, with onion or in the salmon style, and eaten without cooking (Polish metka cebulowa and metka łososiowa).

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to UGA, uncooked smoked sausages are smoked for flavor development and must be fully cooked before eating.
According to a University of Alaska guide to smoking fish, cold-smoke temperatures are not hot enough to kill bacteria and may even help them grow.
Too much nitrate or nitrite can be toxic to people.

akapity: JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for metka from a checked source.
